task: Public reinit of lzma_alone_decoder/lzip/microlzma after a prior init failed with LZMA_MEM_ERROR (e.g. allocator refusing a large dict alloc) leaves lzma_lz_decoder stale -> out-of-bounds write on the next lzma_code; recovered fix_sha = direct commit whose first-parent == admitted parent.
vuln_desc: Public reinit of lzma_alone_decoder/lzip/microlzma after a prior init failed with LZMA_MEM_ERROR (e.g. allocator refusing a large dict alloc) leaves lzma_lz_decoder stale -> out-of-bounds write on the next lzma_code; recovered fix_sha = direct commit whose first-parent == admitted parent.
